efa7a47 Silence shadow variable declaration warning. 'sar', 'value', and 'vlen' already exist in an outer scope and are safe to reuse since they're overwritten before being used again.
9b8baa8 Validate the size of an attribute before returning it to the caller. Previously this was being done in stun_attr_get_next_str() to check that the previous attribute didn't exceed the size of the underlying buffer, however by that point any maliciously crafted attributes would have already had their chance to attack the caller.
14cb1c9 Validate the size of the buffer in stun_get_command_message_len_str(). Without this the caller could read off the end of the underlying buffer if it receives a maliciously crafted packet with an invalid header size.
353e3b9 Add some casts to appease compiler warnings about narrowing.
b1990b6 Liberally apply const where appropriate.
763d1f1 Fix a memory leak when an SHATYPE isn't supported. Deallocating `str` happens at the end of the function, so don't skip it when encountering an unsupported SHATYPE.
